caption: The ladder from the SI base units down to the sensor under test. Accuracy falls at each step down, and each rung is calibrated against the one above — that unbroken set of links is traceability.

items.label: SI base units
items.note: m, kg, s, A, K, mol, cd

spec.aria: A five-layer ladder from the SI base units at the top down through primary, secondary and working standards to the sensor being calibrated, with accuracy falling as you go down.
